jobs.title: Town Planner (Planning Consultancy)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

The Planning Consultancy team in Central Birmingham specialise in providing commercial planning advice to a wide-range of private and public sector clients. It is an established front end development team which advises on development proposals throughout all stages of the planning process from feasibility, plan promotion, application, EIA and appeal. Our projects range from complex city centre regeneration sites, tall buildings, high density housing, strategic housing promotion, repurposing town centres, retail development, sports and leisure, logistics and major business parks, through to detailed listed building reuse. We act for developers, land owners, house builders, registered providers, financial institutions, strategic promoters, retailers and operators. We are proud to be involved in leading some of the region’s largest and most high-profile schemes.

We are looking to recruit an enthusiastic team player with a can do attitude. Candidates must have some private sector consultancy experience as well possibly some local authority experience, a proven ability to deliver to a high standard, strong communication skills, passion to share their knowledge and a desire to learn and contribute to the on-going success of our team.

You will be a Planner with a good knowledge and experience of the planning process including planning applications, permitted development, policy frameworks, plan promotion and the appeal process. You will be well versed in using critical thinking to prepare planning appraisals and strategies, the preparation of all planning documentation for developments, the associated negotiations with planning authorities and stakeholders.

We’re looking for Planners with demonstrable experience, with the confidence and initiative to run projects themselves, but also work within a team on large scale projects.

As one of the world’s leading engineering, professional services and technical consultancy firms, at WSP, we’re passionate about the big questions. And big answers, naturally. For us that’s all about reaching beyond the expected, to do work that’ll make a profound impact felt long into the future.

A Little More About Your Role…

Assisting in the devising planning strategies, assessing site’s planning history and relevant planning policies contained within a development plan; as well as national planning policy and guidance.
Preparing briefing notes that set out the likelihood of achieving planning permission for housing or employment uses.
Drafting planning statements in a clear and persuasive way, to support development proposals.
Assisting in the planning aspects in multidisciplinary teams delivering planning projects.
Attending site visits, design team and client meetings.
Managing project delivery and budgetary control.
Working collaboratively with colleagues from across WSP, for example in the Transport or Sustainability Teams, to ensure their advice is factored into the combined advice provided to clients by WSP.
Monitoring planning applications and liaising with clients and teams to respond to consultation feedback.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Degree level qualification in town planning.
Postgraduate qualification in a relevant subject.
Chartered status (MRTPI / NIPA).
Sound knowledge and experience of the UK planning system, gained in the private sector setting.
Strong technical skills
A commercial approach to planning consultancy and development.
A desire to work in a growing planning team, surrounded and supported by a raft of fellow professionals.
Strong organisational and communication skills.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

jobs.title: Town Planning and Architectural Graduate Programme
jobs.description:
Build a brilliant career. Shape a sustainable tomorrow.

Do you want to build your career with a globally connected, welcoming team? Where you'll be trusted with real responsibility, empowered to contribute to projects that create a more sustainable future - and given the support to develop both professionally and personally?

Take the driver's seat in your career on the AtkinsRéalis Graduate Development Programme, guided by inspiring, supportive managers. And say yes to brilliant opportunities that spark your interest, knowing you'll have training and the support you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

We believe reaching your full potential means being able to bring your whole self to work and feeling like you belong. Find out more about our global programme Different Makes a Difference.

We are AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. Here you’ll help create world-class sustainable solutions that connect people, data, and technology. We're transforming infrastructure and energy systems, growing partnerships with our clients, and bringing the most complex projects across the globe to life.

Our global team of 40,000+ employees speak over 70 languages and represent some 130 nationalities across six continents. Our work covers a variety of sectors, including power, transportation, infrastructure, environment, water, nuclear, technology, defence and aerospace.

Where you could work

You'll have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, develop new skills and gain valuable experience while making a positive impact on people, communities and the environment.

Want to learn more? Explore our markets and learn more about our projects.

What you can bring

A curious mindset and enthusiasm for solving real-world challenges
A desire to champion a culture where everyone belongs
A collaborative working style and confidence building positive relationships
Enthusiasm and drive to develop your skillset and seek out development opportunities within a supportive team
Motivation to achieve professional accreditation (where applicable)
Comfortable embracing agile ways of working and learning new technologies
A commitment to spend a minimum of three days a week in the office or on client site (project dependent). Being together in person helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more effectively, and accelerate your learning and development.

How do I apply?

Click " Apply
" to start your application - you'll be taken to our vacancies platform, where you can explore specific graduate roles that match your interests. On the platform use the search and filter options to narrow down roles by location, sector and other preferences, select the role you'd like to apply for and submit your application.

Please note - you can only make one application

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Job Title:
Customer Success Manager

Locations:
Remote- Highly preferred Eastern or Central Time Zone

: Manager, Customer Success

A quick snapshot…

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) owns a portfolio of Enterprise accounts and is the primary relationship steward between those customers and Conga. Working hand-in-hand with their aligned Sales counterpart, the CSM builds proactive, outcome-driven strategies that deliver measurable value — resulting in strong retention, expansion, and pipeline contribution. Every engagement is anchored in SMART goals developed collaboratively with the customer, tracked rigorously, and used to demonstrate the quantified impact of the Conga platform on the customer's business.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious, energized by complexity, and committed to doing the work of understanding intricate products and workflows so they can translate that knowledge into clear, compelling value for the customer.

Why it’s a big deal…

Enterprise customers chose Conga to power some of the most critical processes in their revenue operations. As a CSM, you are the reason those customers stay, grow, and advocate for us. You won't be reacting to support tickets — you'll be setting the strategic agenda, building executive relationships, co-creating success plans, and proactively identifying opportunities to expand value before the customer even knows they need it. Your fingerprints are on retention, on expansion revenue, and on the pipeline your partnership with Sales helps develop. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role.

Required Experience

Here’s what we’re looking for…

3–5 years of recen
t, hands-on experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or a closely related customer-facing role — with at least some of that experience in an enterprise or complex mid-market environment. We care that your experience is current; this space moves fast and we want someone who has been living it.

Outcome Orientation & SMART Goal Development

You connect what Conga does to what the customer is trying to achieve — and you make that connection concrete. You know how to build a success plan with goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound, and you hold yourself and the customer accountable to tracking progress against them. Customers should always know what 'good' looks like and whether we're getting there.

Proactive Strategy & Sales Alignment

You don't wait for the customer to come to you. You build a point of view on each account, develop it jointly with your Sales counterpart, and show up with a plan. You understand that CSM and Sales working together — with shared context and shared accountability — is how we drive retention, expansion, and pipeline in a way that actually feels good to the customer.

Risk Identification & Mitigation

You read the signals — engagement patterns, stakeholder changes, adoption gaps, unresolved friction — and you act on them before they become problems. When risk surfaces, you don't manage it in isolation. You develop a clear mitigation plan in close partnership with your account team, aligning on the right actions, owners, and timeline to protect the relationship and the business. Proactive risk management is as much a part of this role as celebrating wins.

Curiosity & Product Fluency

Conga's products are sophisticated. The workflows they support are nuanced. You don't need to know everything on day one, but you need to have the genuine curiosity and work ethic to learn — and you need to be the kind of person who finds it interesting, not overwhelming. The CSMs who win here are the ones who can take a complicated platform capability and make a customer understand exactly why it matters for their business.

Communication, Interpersonal Skills & Relationship Building

You're comfortable in a room with a VP, and equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves with an admin working in the system every day. You communicate clearly, you listen well, and you build trust by doing what you say you're going to do. You know how to navigate a difficult conversation without flinching, and you know how to make the customer feel heard even when the answer isn't what they hoped for.

Equally important is how you operate inside Conga. This role requires genuine cross-functional partnership — with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services/Partner team, Support, and Product. You know how to build internal relationships, advocate effectively across teams, and bring the right people into a customer conversation at the right time. Your ability to collaborate internally is just as critical as your ability to show up for the customer.

Confident, Constructive Challenger

You don't just validate what customers are already doing — you partner with them to develop an adoption strategy grounded in what matters most to their business and rooted in the outcomes that brought them to Conga in the first place. If there's a more structured path to achieving those outcomes, you advocate for it — respectfully, persistently, and with the customer's goals front and center. You're not afraid to ask the hard question, push back when it serves the customer, or challenge an approach when you know there's a better way forward.

Self-Motivation, Ownership Mentality & Continuous Growth

You manage your book of business like it's your own. You set your own priorities, track your own commitments, and don't need to be told twice to follow up. You treat every account as if your name is on the outcome — because it is.

But ownership alone isn't enough. We're looking for someone who is driven to continuously improve their craft — someone who understands that the work we do (executive business reviews, strategic account planning, change management strategy, health scoring, adoption planning) isn't a checklist. Every one of those activities connects directly to retention, adoption, expansion, and pipeline. We want a CSM who internalizes that connection, invests in getting better at it, and brings increasing depth and intentionality to their work over time. If you're the kind of person who reads a QBR recap and asks 'how could I have made that more impactful?' — this is the role for you.

Analytical Comfort

You're comfortable working with data to tell a story. You can look at adoption metrics, usage trends, or business KPIs and turn them into a narrative that means something to a customer executive. Familiarity with tools like Gainsight, Salesforce, PowerBI, or Clari is a plus — but the mindset matters more than any specific tool.

Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…

Experience with Revenue Lifecycle Management, contract management, CPQ, or related commercial process platforms

A track record of contributing to expansion or renewal outcomes — not just customer satisfaction scores

About BarnTools

BarnTools makes smart barn monitoring simple. Our gateways, wireless sensors, and mobile and web applications give swine and poultry operations real-time visibility into the conditions that drive animal health and performance — temperature, humidity, water, power, and feed — and put that information in front of the people responsible for acting on it.

Our Customers Rely On Us For

BarnTalk — whole-barn environmental monitoring and alarms, from the Gateway and its sensors to alerts delivered on the BarnTalk mobile app.
BinTalk Pro and Precision Feed — real-time feed inventory and usage from the bin, for growers and for the integrators managing feed across an entire network.
Barn360 — biosecurity movement tracking and policy enforcement across a production system, reconciled in real time.

BarnTools was founded by producers who knew firsthand what an unreliable alarm costs a farm. That perspective still guides us: caretakers are there for the animals, not the technology, so we build tools that are practical, dependable, and easy to use. More than 7,000 growers and 10,000 sites across the country now run on BarnTools, supported by over 100,000 active sensors in the field.

We serve individual growers as well as the large enterprise integrators and production systems they work with, deploying across entire networks of barns and bins. Headquartered in Urbandale, Iowa, we are a remote-friendly company built on teamwork and trust, and we are looking for people who want to make an impact in the industry that feeds the world.

About You

You lead projects that cross teams and hold a date, without formal authority over most of the people doing the work.
You adjust to the room. A service technician, a feed mill manager, a flock supervisor, a veterinarian, and a VP of Production need the same information delivered five different ways, and you can do all five in a week.
You are comfortable teaching. Running a training session for a room of operations staff is a normal part of your week.
You understand your responsibility of being the voice of our Enterprise customers internally. You are the connection between the customer and the BarnTools Product & Engineering team, and you need to be an advocate for changes and new feature requests.
You learn quickly and go deep — into swine and poultry production, into our hardware and software, and into how a specific integrator actually operates.
You build the plan. The timeline, the training schedule, the follow-up list, and the status update come from you rather than from someone assigning them to you.
You practice Compassionate Curiosity: you ask real discovery questions, respectfully challenge, and carry what you learn back to the Product & Engineering departments.
You use data to drive engagement. You can read adoption and alerting data and know which account needs attention before it asks.
You write clearly and document decisions, so a colleague can pick up your account without a phone call.
You stay steady when things go sideways. A failed install, a slipped date, or a frustrated executive is a problem to work, not a crisis.

Key Responsibilities

Own the account.

Serve as the primary point of contact for a named set of enterprise customers, managing the full post-sale lifecycle against business outcomes and identifying growth within those accounts. Your mission is to delight our customers, maximize customer ROI, and build lifetime value.

Run enterprise deployments.

Own the customer side of pilot-to-rollout programs across large grower networks in the US and Canada. This means prioritizing the moments that matter to the customer, understanding how each of them is defining success for each pilot, and working in partnership with sales to ensure every pilot leads to broader adoption and expansion.

Deliver the training.

You personally train the customer's operations and staff — service technicians, flock supervisors, feed mill managers, production personnel — on the hardware, the BarnTalk mobile app, and the web portal, virtually or on site. For the grower side of the network, you own the training plan and the communications around it and coordinate delivery with the teams running grower onboarding.

Drive adoption, not just installation.

Hardware on the wall is the start. Track whether alerts are configured, call trees are populated, and the BarnTalk app is actually in the hands of the people who need it — and intervene where it is not.

Be the product expert.

Teach customers the hardware, the mobile app, and the web portal: Gateway, BinTalk Pro, tandem bins, feed alerts, alarm configuration, and account structure including Additional Gateway Owner setup.

Run executive-level reviews.

Deliver business reviews that show the customer what they are getting for their spend, in their metrics, not ours.

Advocate internally.

Bring continuous, specific feedback to Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering, including participation in testing and customer engagement on new functionality.

Document the work.

Keep HubSpot current, post standardized internal call summaries so stakeholders can follow an account without asking, and contribute to the Help Center and internal knowledge base.

Raise the floor.

Improve the playbooks, templates, and standards the Enterprise CS team runs on as we continue to scale.

Required

Experience and qualifications

3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Solution Engineering, or an equivalent role with a strong focus on communication, consulting, influencing, project management, and building relationships.
Direct experience owning enterprise or strategic accounts — multi-stakeholder organizations where the buyer, the operator, and the end user are three different people.
Demonstrated ability to run a structured implementation or rollout program to a date, coordinating groups you do not manage.
Proven communication and presentation skills, with real comfort delivering consultative recommendations to executives and management teams over video and in person.
Proven ability to understand complex problems and explain their source simply.
Technical savvy: you can hold a credible conversation about connectivity, sensors, alerting logic, and an integration without handing every question to engineering.
Self-starter who manages time and prioritizes competing demands without being sequenced by a manager.
Comfortable in a remote environment with stable internet and a quiet space.

Preferred

Background in agriculture — swine or poultry production especially — or a demonstrated willingness to learn the industry to the depth this role requires. Biosecurity awareness is a plus.
Experience with hardware plus SaaS, where the customer experience includes a physical install and an ongoing subscription.
Familiarity with HubSpot and modern CS tooling, plus the working stack we use day to day (Slack, Asana, Granola, Guru).
Certifications in Customer Success and/or Project Management.
Experience with enterprise integrations or data exchange between platforms.
Undergraduate degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience, with preference to Ag, Business, or MIS.

What We Offer

A fast-paced environment where your ideas can be acted on quickly. We default to action.
A seat on the team connecting the world's farms, in an industry that is only now being digitized.
Work from home (US based) or from our office in Urbandale, Iowa.

Coverage Review & Compliance Monitoring

Validate that coverages listed on Certificates of Insurance meet required standards, limits, and specifications, and identify and document any deficiencies or non-compliance.

Compile requests for waivers of insurance requirements and route them, with supporting documentation, to the appropriate leader or account team for approval under established guidelines.

Renewal Tracking & Certificate Management

Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of compliance status, partner communications, and resolution actions.

Managing project delivery and budgetary control.

A quick snapshot…

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) owns a portfolio of Enterprise accounts and is the primary relationship steward between those customers and Conga. Working hand-in-hand with their aligned Sales counterpart, the CSM builds proactive, outcome-driven strategies that deliver measurable value — resulting in strong retention, expansion, and pipeline contribution. Every engagement is anchored in SMART goals developed collaboratively with the customer, tracked rigorously, and used to demonstrate the quantified impact of the Conga platform on the customer's business.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious, energized by complexity, and committed to doing the work of understanding intricate products and workflows so they can translate that knowledge into clear, compelling value for the customer.

Why it’s a big deal…

Enterprise customers chose Conga to power some of the most critical processes in their revenue operations. As a CSM, you are the reason those customers stay, grow, and advocate for us. You won't be reacting to support tickets — you'll be setting the strategic agenda, building executive relationships, co-creating success plans, and proactively identifying opportunities to expand value before the customer even knows they need it. Your fingerprints are on retention, on expansion revenue, and on the pipeline your partnership with Sales helps develop. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role.

Required Experience

Here’s what we’re looking for…

3–5 years of recen
t, hands-on experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or a closely related customer-facing role — with at least some of that experience in an enterprise or complex mid-market environment. We care that your experience is current; this space moves fast and we want someone who has been living it.

Outcome Orientation & SMART Goal Development

You connect what Conga does to what the customer is trying to achieve — and you make that connection concrete. You know how to build a success plan with goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound, and you hold yourself and the customer accountable to tracking progress against them. Customers should always know what 'good' looks like and whether we're getting there.

Proactive Strategy & Sales Alignment

You don't wait for the customer to come to you. You build a point of view on each account, develop it jointly with your Sales counterpart, and show up with a plan. You understand that CSM and Sales working together — with shared context and shared accountability — is how we drive retention, expansion, and pipeline in a way that actually feels good to the customer.

Risk Identification & Mitigation

You read the signals — engagement patterns, stakeholder changes, adoption gaps, unresolved friction — and you act on them before they become problems. When risk surfaces, you don't manage it in isolation. You develop a clear mitigation plan in close partnership with your account team, aligning on the right actions, owners, and timeline to protect the relationship and the business. Proactive risk management is as much a part of this role as celebrating wins.

Curiosity & Product Fluency

Conga's products are sophisticated. The workflows they support are nuanced. You don't need to know everything on day one, but you need to have the genuine curiosity and work ethic to learn — and you need to be the kind of person who finds it interesting, not overwhelming. The CSMs who win here are the ones who can take a complicated platform capability and make a customer understand exactly why it matters for their business.

Communication, Interpersonal Skills & Relationship Building

You're comfortable in a room with a VP, and equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves with an admin working in the system every day. You communicate clearly, you listen well, and you build trust by doing what you say you're going to do. You know how to navigate a difficult conversation without flinching, and you know how to make the customer feel heard even when the answer isn't what they hoped for.

Equally important is how you operate inside Conga. This role requires genuine cross-functional partnership — with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services/Partner team, Support, and Product. You know how to build internal relationships, advocate effectively across teams, and bring the right people into a customer conversation at the right time. Your ability to collaborate internally is just as critical as your ability to show up for the customer.

Confident, Constructive Challenger

You don't just validate what customers are already doing — you partner with them to develop an adoption strategy grounded in what matters most to their business and rooted in the outcomes that brought them to Conga in the first place. If there's a more structured path to achieving those outcomes, you advocate for it — respectfully, persistently, and with the customer's goals front and center. You're not afraid to ask the hard question, push back when it serves the customer, or challenge an approach when you know there's a better way forward.

Self-Motivation, Ownership Mentality & Continuous Growth

You manage your book of business like it's your own. You set your own priorities, track your own commitments, and don't need to be told twice to follow up. You treat every account as if your name is on the outcome — because it is.

But ownership alone isn't enough. We're looking for someone who is driven to continuously improve their craft — someone who understands that the work we do (executive business reviews, strategic account planning, change management strategy, health scoring, adoption planning) isn't a checklist. Every one of those activities connects directly to retention, adoption, expansion, and pipeline. We want a CSM who internalizes that connection, invests in getting better at it, and brings increasing depth and intentionality to their work over time. If you're the kind of person who reads a QBR recap and asks 'how could I have made that more impactful?' — this is the role for you.

Analytical Comfort

You're comfortable working with data to tell a story. You can look at adoption metrics, usage trends, or business KPIs and turn them into a narrative that means something to a customer executive. Familiarity with tools like Gainsight, Salesforce, PowerBI, or Clari is a plus — but the mindset matters more than any specific tool.

Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…

Experience with Revenue Lifecycle Management, contract management, CPQ, or related commercial process platforms
Exposure to working in a defined success methodology (e.g., structured QBRs, formal health scoring, executive business reviews)
A track record of contributing to expansion or renewal outcomes — not just customer satisfaction scores

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a trusted C-Suite / executive level advisor on ServiceNow offerings, the Principal Customer Success Executive (PCSE) owns the post-sale customer relationship, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and drive retention through Impact delivery. Principal CSEs are experienced individuals who bring a consultative, problem-solving approach to partnering with senior customer stakeholders to derive value from our platforms. They demonstrate a strong understanding of customer’s industry and specific business strategies, driving alignment between these factors and what ServiceNow can offer to enable better business outcomes for their customers. This role drives business transformation by maximizing the long-term strategic value of ServiceNow and ensuring that every aspect of the customer’s platform and capability are ready for expansion.

They provide strategic direction and mentorship to both customers and ServiceNow teams managing complex, multi-workstream programs. They play a pivotal role in resolving escalations and mitigating risks, ensuring adoption and usage is maintained at healthy levels. Principal CSEs focus on ensuring the customer recognizes the value of the ServiceNow Platform at all levels and stages, facilitating a smooth path to both renewal and up- and cross-sell.

Overall, Principal CSEs are responsible for fostering the relationship with C-suite level stakeholders in a smaller number of strategically important Impact accounts, with the aim of increasing customer satisfaction and driving retention and upgrades, where applicable.

Job Responsibilities

Lead high-complexity transformations in our largest and most strategic customers, ensuring all ServiceNow Customer Excellence roles align and deliver in accordance with governance frameworks, customer objectives, and organizational priorities; ultimately chaperoning Impact value management and demonstrating strategic oversight.
Proactively identify professional services pipeline opportunities through product capabilities road mapping, value blueprints and adoption analysis, providing pre-sales support for funnel opportunities as requested.
Partner with Impact team members (e.g., Customer Success Managers) leveraging the joint visibility of customer insights to create executive-ready narratives.
Work with senior executives to shape and influence customer organizational strategy by identifying emerging trends, refining best practices, and aligning delivery approaches with evolving market demands, and providing industry-specific thought leadership.
Drive operational consistency and excellence by standardizing delivery methodologies and ensuring adherence to governance and quality standards, interfacing with Delivery as required.
Establish relationships with ServiceNow leaders, advocating for product evolution based on customer insights, and mentoring other Customer Success resources on transformation best practices.
Identify areas of risk and take steps to prevent customer or revenue churn.
Work closely with Sales Teams to define and execute product adoption and customer retention plans.
Provide prescriptive guidance on internal project/program governance and help the customer create the appropriate governance models and ensure adherence.
Help the customer identify incidents where contractual SLAs were missed and take necessary action.
Improve overall customer satisfaction, as well as the satisfaction of their internal customers.

Torch Dental is a high-growth, venture-backed vertical SaaS company transforming how dental practices run their businesses. Our mission is to give every dental office the modern software, automation, and visibility they need to operate efficiently and profitably.

About the Role

Customer Success Manager
is a foundational role focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience and driving value across a book of small to mid-sized accounts. You’ll guide customers through onboarding, support their early adoption, and proactively work to retain and grow their relationship with Torch.

In this role, you’ll use core skills in customer engagement, platform expertise, and will be heavily focused on retention and renewals. You’ll also play an important role in capturing customer feedback, identifying patterns, and collaborating cross-functionally to improve the overall experience. Track account health, flag potential risks early, and surface retention concerns to the team.
Help customers get the most out of Torch’s features, especially those related to cost savings, time efficiency, and vendor consolidation.
Use data and platform insights to personalize outreach and demonstrate value (savings, time saved, etc.)

Provide feedback to the product, supplier, and operations teams based on customer conversations.
Support pilot programs or process experiments in cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering and supplier teams.
